Type: soft fleece throw with scalloped edges
Use: warmth on a sofa, armchair or bed, napping, layering; living room, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, farmhouse
Materials: soft brushed polyester fleece
Colors: off-white, warm cream
